stem.en: A cargo ship registered in Panama is 600 nautical miles from the nearest coast. A crew member is hurt on board. Whose law applies to the ship?

text.en: Panama's law, as the flag state

feedback.en: Yes. On the high seas the laws of the flag state apply, and Panama is where this ship is registered.

text.en: The law of the nearest coast

feedback.en: 600 nautical miles is far beyond any EEZ, so this ship is on the high seas, where the flag state's law applies.

text.en: The law of the crew's countries

feedback.en: On the high seas it is the flag state's law that applies to the ship.

text.en: No law at all on the high seas

feedback.en: The high seas do have law. The ship keeps the law of its flag state.

explanation.en: On the high seas, the laws of the flag state apply. The flag state is the country in which a ship is registered. This ship is registered in Panama, so Panama's law applies.

hints.en: Which country is linked to the ship itself?
The flag state is the country in which a ship is registered.
